title: Make the launcher watcher-ordering test wait for the warning instead of holding its fixture a fixed ten seconds
outcome: Make the launcher watcher-ordering test wait for the warning instead of holding its fixture a fixed ten seconds
acceptance: The test "a blocking call still running at its warning time is named once while it runs" in scripts/test-launcher-tests/registration.mjs parks its nested fixture until the parent observes the warning, then releases it and verifies its return marker, with a watchdog for a missing warning; it no longer holds a fixed ten-second sleep on every run
